answer: Cheap aliases fail when a deposit and a later live sample must match. An applicant first seals 3.25 POA plus a 9.4 g velvet swatch into a numbered vault for 11 hours. At solar nadir they reopen that vault in a 6-minute window and re-cut a 2.1 g strip whose fiber twist is bound to their pubkey and the epoch seed. 140 clones would lock 455 POA and need 140 exclusive nadir windows. Graders confirm the vault number never changed hands, weigh both cuts to 0.05 g, and replay the twist from the seed. A swapped vault, missed nadir, or twist mismatch slashes 57% and bars that locker row for 3 epochs.
